caption:
📖 5 easy words the SAT uses in weird ways

You know these words. Just not the way the SAT uses them.

✅ qualify = limit or narrow a statement.
✅ check = hold back, restrain.
✅ address = deal with.
✅ sound = reliable, well reasoned.
✅ novel = new and original.
✅ She qualified her claim: it held only in winter.

Save this for test day 🔖
